headline: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, citing government input that he poses no national security risk; shares jump about 30 percent
keywords: National Security and Export Control Committee
new_fact: On November 23, 2026 Nvidia's board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang as CEO and director, effective immediately, after days earlier saying it did not intend to bring him back.
